effective_for: Prospective balanced reviews after the 2026-10-10 user revision; frozen v1 decisions stay unchanged

comparison.baseline: Latest verified actual effective pool and its frozen member versions
comparison.construction: Direction-aligned 1%-99% winsorization, cross-sectional Z-score, equal factor signals, top-decile equal-weight long holdings
comparison.cagr_delta50_not_negative: strong_increment_target; cost sensitivity is a review item
comparison.recent_compounded_net_return_not_worse: strong_increment_target; shorter or weaker recent evidence is explicitly reviewed

score_rules.A_B_pool_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of eligible per-factor scores using the explicitly verified denominator
score_rules.ICIR: Mean Pearson IC divided by sample standard deviation (ddof=1), not annualized
score_rules.B: Only completed post-effective observations for the unchanged factor version; historical research is not official B
score_rules.B_denominator_unverified: pending; do not silently assume all pool members or only mature members
score_rules.C_Sharpe: Mean cost-adjusted absolute daily portfolio return divided by sample standard deviation, times sqrt(252); risk-free return is zero
score_rules.aggregation: Compute and clip each complete calendar month first, then aggregate the paired months
score_rules.monthly_nav_reset: Reset the scoring NAV baseline, preserve actual carried positions and cash
score_rules.missing_B_or_official_ledger: Research A+C proxy only; official total-points gain remains unverified

single_factor_sharpe_policy.role: Minimum standalone quality floor for each added or changed candidate, recomputed from the bound held-decile daily net ledger; research and official exploration remain separate
single_factor_sharpe_policy.supersedes: Latest user clarification on 2026-10-10 replaces the no-cutoff instruction with a modest formal admission floor; legacy 2 and 2.5 thresholds remain retired
single_factor_sharpe_policy.portfolio_review: Passing the standalone floor does not replace pool increments, costs, stability or evidence checks; pure removal and unchanged existing members are exempt

evidence_policy.artifact_binding: Existing file SHA256, candidate definition, pool member versions, window, cycle, groups, costs and source scope

grading.strong_increment: Complete evidence meets v1 portfolio targets, with positive standard-cost net economics and no return/risk/cost deterioration
grading.small_increment_review: Positive standard-cost pool CAGR and A+C increment, no negative tradeoff, but Sharpe increment or A+C relative gain is below the strong target
grading.tradeoff_review: Verified improvement on at least one net-return, score, Sharpe, risk or fee axis, with saturation, incomplete target horizon or deterioration elsewhere
grading.rejected: Complete certified evidence has no explanatory improvement or standard-cost pool net profit, relative net excess or absolute Sharpe is nonpositive
grading.missing_evidence: pending; a review tier cannot replace hash, scope, independent calendar or execution evidence
grading.shadow_validation: Small improvements and tradeoffs may enter frozen shadow validation; completed shadow data and three IC observations meet the currently observed ICIR sample minimum but do not prove statistical or official score validity
grading.official_research_separate: Source probes and official exploratory retests do not need prior pool admission, 200 research periods or 24 paired months; executable-source/replay and independently authorized budgets still apply
